verdict.rationale: Loops explicitly documents the core of this story: creating draft campaigns, content included, through the API, then reviewing and sending them from the dashboard. That is a human-approval gate before send. Its API covers creating and managing campaigns, content and themes. MCP, CLI and skills give agents access, and campaigns are documented as one-time sends to a segment. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the API or agent can attach a segment or audience to the draft, any documented scheduling or queued-send state, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the draft-to-approval flow.
